summary: Former tower site in Smyth County, Virginia; the Association lists it as gone, and the sources read say nothing more about its history.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone by the Association; no source read describes what, if anything, remains at the site.

evidence.supports: Tower in Smyth County, listed as Gone
Forest Lookouts files the entry under Smyth County - National Forest

notes_for_editor: Thin record: only the Association's Virginia list (Tower, Gone, coordinates) and the Forest Lookouts Virginia list (Smyth County - National Forest) support the story. Two searches and several page reads found no build date, design, staffing, removal date or photo. A guessed firetower.org register URL returned 404, and the Association's list gives no register link for Quebec Knob. The Dickey Knob register entry (http://www.firetower.org/lookouts/us/va/dickey-knob-tower-site/) says Dickey Knob was one of only two towers in Smyth County (built 1934, removed before 1994), but it does not name the other, so it is not used. An AllTrails search snippet describes a visitor finding no remains; the page returned 403 and the snippet is not used. Access is unknown. The story is shorter than the 120-word guide because the evidence is that thin.
